greeting: Egameni likaYise, nelikaNyana, nelikaMoya oyiNgcwele. Makube noxolo lweNkosi yethu uYesu Kristu kuni nonke.
penitential: Nkosi, siqukile ngenceba yakho. Kristu, siqukile ngenceba yakho. Nkosi, siqukile ngenceba yakho.
psalm_response: Eminyakeni yonke, Nkosi, ube lilizibuko lethu.
homily:
Kukho umzuzu omnye endiwucingayo namhlanje, umfanekiso othi cwaka kodwa onamandla. Khumbula uBenjamin Vo ehlezi kwitafile yakhe, ebukele iindiza ezinkulu zihamba kwisikrini sakhe, okanye mhlawumbi ecinga ngendlela yokwakha ikhowudi entsha yomdlalo wakhe. Wayengumfana owayethanda ukuphakamisa amehlo akhe, ebukela indlela izinto ezisebenza ngayo, ebukela ubomi buhamba ngesantya esikhawulezayo, njengendiza i-Boeing 737 ekhwela emoyeni. UBen wayengumfana owayenomdla ongenamida, kodwa ngaphezu koko, wayeyindoda encane eyayiphethe intliziyo ethambileyo, intliziyo eyayisoloko ikulungele ukunika.

Namhlanje, kwiNcwadi yeZaci, uQoheleth usikhumbuza into ebonakala inzima: 'Izeze lezeze, konke kuli-zeze.' Uthi ilanga liyaphuma, liyaphuma, umoya ujikeleza, imilambo iye elwandle kodwa ulwandle aluze luzale. Kukhangeleka ngathi akukho nto intsha phantsi kwelanga. Xa sijonga ubomi bethu, ngamanye amaxesha siziva ngolu hlobo. Sicinga ukuba konke kuli-zeze, ukuba imizamo yethu, iintlungu zethu, kunye nokulahlekelwa kwethu akukho ntsingiselo. Alan noThao, ndiyazi ukuba le yindlela eniziva ngayo ngamanye amaxesha. Sekuphele iinyanga ezintathu uBen esishiye, kwaye indlu iziva ithule kakhulu. Xa ucinga ngaloo mntwana wakho owayekuthanda kakhulu, owayekulalele xa ubalisa amabali akho, owayekuthanda kakhulu njengoba wayekuthanda ukuhamba nawe, Ryan, usizi aluhambi ngokwekhalenda. Niyazibuza ukuba kutheni lo mfana owayephila ngothando, owayephila ngobubele, kufuneka ahambe ngolu hlobo. Niyazibuza ukuba kukhona na eninokukwenza ngcono. Ndicela niphulaphule: Ukugula akulona iphutha lenu. Akukho nto eniyenze ngendlela engalunganga. UThixo akakubeki icala, kwaye noBen akakubeki icala. Susa lowo mthwalo wokuzisola egxalabeni lakho. Awuphosanga nto. Ubenze konke okusemandleni enu ngothando olungapheliyo. UThixo akathumeli ukugula. Ezinye izinto zenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lwethu, ngaphandle kokuba nabani na enze impazamo. Niyinyaniso, nithandwa nguThixo, kwaye uBen ukhululekile kuyo yonke intlungu.

KwiVangeli yanamhlanje, uHerode uva ngako konke okwenzekayo, kwaye uyamangaliswa. Uthi, 'UJohane ndimqumle intloko. Ngubani lo endiva ezi zinto ngaye?' UHerode wayefuna ukumbona uYesu, kodwa wayefuna ukumbona ngamehlo okukrokrela, ngamehlo omntu ocinga ukuba konke kungumdlalo wamandla. Kodwa uYesu wayengengomdlalo wamandla. WayenguNyana kaThixo owayezile ukuzonika ubomi. Ben wayengumfana owayeyiqonda le nto. Khumbula indlela uBen awayenomsa ngayo, umzekelo xa wayefuna ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yakhe yasebhange encinci ukuze ancede umalume wakhe uWilliam. Akazange ayiphule loo ngulube yemali, akazange ayikhuphule ngokoqobo, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe. Wayengumfana onikela ngayo yonke into yakhe. Lo moya wokunika waba yindlela yakhe yokuphila.

Nani, nikani konke usizi lwenu kuThixo. Musani ukuzama ukuluthwala lodwa. Vumelani uYesu ukuba abe lulwalwa lwenu. Xa uziva usizi, yithi: 'Nkosi, ndiyakuthanda, kwaye ndiyakuthemba.' UBen uyaqhubeka esidumisela kuThixo. Uthando lwenu luyaqhubeka luhleli, lusaqhubeka lukhula, kwaye uBen uyaqhubeka ekhanya. Benjamin, lala ngokuthula. Uthando lwakho lulukhanya olungasoze lwavaleleka. Uthando lwakho, njengaloo mthombo wamanzi eCà Mau, luyaqhubeka luhleli, lusaqhubeka lukhula, kwaye luyaqhubeka lukhanyisa iindlela zethu. Khumbula ukuba uBen uyaqhubeka esidumisela kuThixo, kwaye nathi, simele siphile ngaloo ndlela—ngothando olungagciniyo, ngoxolelo olungapheliyo, nangokholo olomeleleyo. Ryan, mfowethu omncane, uBen uyamthanda. Ungalokothi uzive ungedwa. UBen uyaqhubeka ekukhathalele. Qhubeka uphila ngesibindi, ube ngumfana owayeyiyo—onemfesane, onobubele, nonesibindi. UBen uyaqhubeka ekhanya ngomsebenzi wakhe wothando. Uthando lwakhe aluzange luphele; lusaqhubeka lukhanya njengolwandle olukhulu. Nani, Alan noThao, ningayeki ukuthanda. Nithandeke kakhulu nguThixo. UBen wayengumfana onikela ngayo yonke into yakhe. Nani, nikani konke usizi lwenu kuThixo. Musani ukuzama ukuluthwala lodwa. Vumelani uYesu ukuba abe lulwalwa lwenu. Ngamanye amaxesha, sicinga ukuba iindlela zikaThixo kufuneka zifane nezi zethu. Kodwa uThixo uthi: 'Iingcinga zam azizo iingcinga zenu, neendlela zam azizo iendlela zenu.' Oku kunzima ukukwamkela xa siphulukene nomntu esimthandayo. Kodwa khumbula, Alan noThao, ukuba uBen uyaqhubeka ekhanya ngomsebenzi wakhe wothando. Uthando lwakhe aluzange luphele; lusaqhubeka lugeza umhlaba njengolwandle olukhulu. Nani, ningayeki ukuthanda. Nithandeke kakhulu nguThixo. UBen wayengumfana onikela ngayo yonke into yakhe. Uthando lwakho lulukhanya olungasoze lwavaleleka. Uthando lwakho, njengaloo mthombo wamanzi, luyaqhubeka luhleli, lusaqhubeka lukhula, kwaye luyaqhubeka lukhanyisa iindlela zethu. Khumbula ukuba uBen uyaqhubeka esidumisela kuThixo, kwaye nathi, simele siphile ngaloo ndlela—ngothando olungagciniyo, ngoxolelo olungapheliyo, nangokholo olomeleleyo. Benjamin, lala ngokuthula. Amen.
petitions: Sikhulekela uBenjamin Vo nabo bonke abasishiyeyo, ukuze baphumle ekukhanyeni kukaKristu.
Sikhulekela bonke abazilayo, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele abanike ithemba.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona ngokwenene kwiSakramente eliNgcwele. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwako konke, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Ekubeni ngoku ndingenakukwamkela ngokwenene kwiSakramente, nceda uze kum ngomoya nangothando. Ndiyakwamkela njengokungathi sele ulapha, kwaye ndizimanyanisa ngokupheleleyo nawe. Ungandivumeli ndahlukane nawe nanini. Amen.
closing: Ngamana uThixo onamandla angasigcina emxholweni wothando lwakhe, ngoku naphakade. Amen.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuQala
readings.text: Izeze lezeze, utsho uQoheleth, izeze lezeze! Konke kuli-zeze! Yintoni inzuzo yomntu kuko konke ukusebenza kwakhe phantsi kwelanga? Isizukulwana siyadlula, esinye size, kodwa umhlaba uhleli ngonaphakade. Ilanga liyaphuma, ilanga liyashona, lize libuyele apho liphuma khona. Umoya uvuthuza usiya emzantsi, ujikeleze uye emantla; umoya ujikeleza ubuya, uze uphinde iindlela zawo. Yonke imilambo iya elwandle, kodwa ulwandle aluze luzale. Imilambo ibuyela apho ivelayo khona, ukuze iphinde iqhube. Konke ukuthetha kunzima; akukho nto umntu anokuyithetha. Iliso alihluthi kukubona, nendlebe ayihluthi kukuva. Into ebibekho, yiyo eya kubakho; into eyenziweyo, yiyo eya kwenziwa. Akukho nto intsha phantsi kwelanga. Nokuba yinto esithi ngayo, 'Jonga, le yintsha!' sele ikho kumaxesha adlulileyo. Akukho sikhumbuzo sabantu bakudala; nabaza kuza emva kwethu abayi kukhunjulwa ngabo baza kuza emva kwabo.

readings.label: INdumiso yokuPhendula
readings.text: R. Eminyakeni yonke, Nkosi, ube lilizibuko lethu. Ujika umntu abuyele eluthulini, usithi, 'Buyani, nina bantwana babantu.' Kuba iminyaka eliwaka emehlweni akho injengezolo, xa lidlulile, okanye njengomlindi wasebusuku. R. Eminyakeni yonke, Nkosi, ube lilizibuko lethu. Ubanika ukuphela ebuthongweni babo; ngentsasa elandelayo bafana nengca etshintshayo, Ehluma ngokutsha ekuseni, kodwa ngokuhlwa iyabuna iyaphela. R. Eminyakeni yonke, Nkosi, ube lilizibuko lethu. Sifundise ukubala iintsuku zethu ngokuchanekileyo, ukuze sifumane ubulumko bentliziyo. Buyela, Nkosi! Kude kube nini? Yiba nenceba kubakhonzi bakho! R. Eminyakeni yonke, Nkosi, ube lilizibuko lethu. Sihluthise ekuseni ngenceba yakho, ukuze simemeze ngovuyo nangolwazi yonke imihla yethu. Yenza uphumelele umsebenzi wezandla zethu! Yenza uphumelele umsebenzi wezandla zethu! R. Eminyakeni yonke, Nkosi, ube lilizibuko lethu.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: UHerode umphathi-mimandla weva ngako konke okwenzekayo, waza wamangaliswa kakhulu kuba abanye babesithi, 'UJohane uvusiwe kwabafileyo'; abanye besithi, 'UEliya ubonakele'; abanye besithi, 'Omnye wabaprofeti bakudala uvukile.' Kodwa uHerode wathi, 'UJohane ndimqumle intloko. Ngubani lo endiva ezi zinto ngaye?' Waza waqhubeka ezama ukumbona.

day: Thursday of the Twenty-fifth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.

Ben ơi, ba nhớ con nhiều quá.

Mommy cũng vậy. Hơn hai tháng rồi mà ba má vẫn khóc mỗi ngày.

Con giúp ba má vượt qua nha, để lo cho em
Hey Ben,  nếu có thể hãy cho anh Minh gặp Ben trong giấc mơ nhé, dù chỉ là lời chào hay nụ cười như cách Ben vẫn hay tạo dáng để chụp hình. Nhớ và thương Ben nhiều lắm
